mechanism.claim: A source-complete UTC day in which at least four of six liquid alt perpetuals share unusually strong normalized aggressive quote flow represents broad crypto demand or supply that should propagate into BTC for twelve hours during elevated BTC variation.
mechanism.side: strict majority sign of six alt daily normalized aggressive quote flows; BTC flow and price direction are never inputs

external_basis.paper: Order Flow and Cryptocurrency Returns: A Machine Learning Approach with Out-of-Sample Validation
external_basis.reported_result: daily cryptocurrency order flow has out-of-sample return-predictive power and dominates economic fundamentals
external_basis.adaptation: transparent cross-alt median consensus and causal high-variation gate without fitted model or outcome-selected coefficient

mechanism.why_distinct: CAFLR uses hourly alt-flow majority only when BTC flow disagrees. CAFAER uses day-over-day flow changes confirmed by BTC and fades them. HVCAQF uses only quarter-hour opening windows and failed structural proximity. HVDCAFC uses one full-day alt-only flow level, excludes BTC flow and price direction, follows consensus, and reuses no event set or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC daily variation must occupy its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily alt-only flow consensus clock is sparse and absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_day: 1,440 exact coherent bars_binance one-minute rows [D-24h,D) independently for each alt and BTC
features.normalized_alt_flow: sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume)/sum(quote_asset_volume) per alt; positive denominator and finite strict nonzero
features.consensus: at least four of six alt flow signs share one direction; 3-3 rejects
features.consensus_strength: median absolute normalized flow among only direction-confirming alts, finite strict positive
features.strength_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 source-valid days, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.60
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTC one-minute open-to-close log returns over completed day), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 source-valid days, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty
clock.rv20: q90 only after unchanged all-stage pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable-then-adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: paper-supported daily order-flow predictability expressed through alt-only breadth

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, day, flow, breadth, strength, history, rank, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, source, or control repair
